visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a macro close-up of dozens of sausages and glutinous rice sausages roasting over a charcoal grill. A person wearing blue disposable gloves uses metal tongs to expertly flip and rearrange the sausages while thick white smoke billows around the food. The lighting is bright and natural. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a customer queue inside a small, brightly lit shop with wooden walls. Several people are seen from the back, waiting their turn. (3) A close-up shot follows, showing a hand using a black pen to write an order on a notepad attached to a clipboard. (4) Back at the grill, a man wearing a grey t-shirt and a dark face mask is seen from the chest up, tending to the sausages. He then uses a large butcher knife to slice the hot sausages on a weathered wooden cutting board. (5) A white paper plate is shown, piled high with sliced sausages, rice sausages, and raw garlic cloves. Yellow and green squeeze bottles are visible in the background on a red table. (6) Multiple close-up shots feature individual slices of rice sausage being held up by a wooden skewer, highlighting the texture of the rice and peanuts inside. (7) A stream of dark brown sauce is drizzled over the plate of food. (8) The final sequence shows rows of raw sausages hanging from a rack, followed by a wide shot of the shop's exterior showing its sign, tables, and the surrounding street environment under clear, sunny skies.

(7) [Subtitle]: 現烤現切. (8) [Subtitle]: 每一份都有濃郁的炭香味. (9) [Subtitle]: 這樣滿滿一盤下午茶超過癮. (10) [Subtitle]: 一定要試試. (11) [Subtitle]: 大腸頭做的糯米腸. (12) [Subtitle]: 老闆娘說每天只有限量20份. (13) [Subtitle]: 還有最多人買的大腸. (14) [Subtitle]: 薄嫩豬腸衣包糯米. (15) [Subtitle]: 軟黏好吃. (16) [Subtitle]: 淋醬享用更美味. (17) [Subtitle]: 炭烤香腸口感扎實. (18) [Subtitle]: 帶點酒香味. (19) [Subtitle]: 搭配蒜頭或醃小黃瓜更刷嘴. (20) [Subtitle]: 愛吃香腸糯米腸快去試試. (21) [Subtitle]: 這裡也有販售生香腸哦. (22) [Slogan]: 橋邊香腸攤 高雄市鳳山區光遠路68號. (23) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (24) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉. (25) [Logo]: 橋邊香腸攤.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional food vlog designed to showcase a traditional 40-year-old grilled sausage stand in Kaohsiung. It aims to entice viewers with high-quality close-ups of sizzling food, detailed descriptions of its unique ingredients (like the large intestine casing rice sausages), and a friendly recommendation.
